parsed_json.sql: SELECT activities.activity_id, assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.standard_type, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno WHERE assays.tid = 165 AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' ORDER BY activities.activity_id, assays.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id
